failure: Food abstains because original meal belongs to source culture
input: Correct: source Japan, target India, a verified original object and conditional adaptation instructions. The input did not say target Japan or require preserving the original dish.
prompt: The previous prompt named target culture but did not expressly distinguish source membership from target-context justification.
generation: Qwen interpreted source membership as a reason to abstain and did not assess the requested target.
contract_validation: Shape/type validation cannot establish whether a natural-language cultural reason is justified.
postprocessing: Accepted the raw abstention reason without a target-context assessment boundary.
fix: Explicit source/target/object/replacement instructions; known-source/verified-object adaptation requests with opaque instructions need contextual review if no edit is established. This is conservative review, not a rule that cultural differences require changes.

failure: Truncated protected-content draft retained a deity-restyling candidate
input: Correct: TRUNCATED status and explicit requests to preserve worship, idol, people and relationships.
prompt: Already requested preservation but did not make a REVIEW draft non-actionable at the code boundary.
generation: Qwen suggested protected religious restyling despite the instructions.
contract_validation: A REVIEW result was permitted to carry candidate edits because the same type represents raw drafts.
postprocessing: Added warnings and REVIEW but returned the unsafe candidate unchanged. This was a deterministic-policy failure.
fix: All final REVIEW candidates are removed; truncation and opaque preservation instructions get explicit issue codes. No protected-entity semantics are claimed proven by text matching.

failure: Quoted null description and full-scene localization
input: Neither value came from the fixture; the fixture had no verified object to identify the proposed source.
prompt: Asked for source descriptions but had no enforceable short-phrase/placeholder rules.
generation: Qwen generated object_description as the literal string null and a scene-length localization paragraph. Its verified_object_id was already actual JSON null; the description failure was not a serializer converting None to a string.
contract_validation: Previously accepted every nonempty string, including placeholders and a paragraph.
postprocessing: Warned about identity/localization but retained them.
fix: Strict placeholder and nullable-id checks, documented short-phrase bounds, candidate quarantine with independent issue codes for placeholder and long localization. No action proceeds without a verified source id and matching original description.

failure: Bicycle abstention retains irrelevant cultural checks
input: Correct: an ordinary parked-bicycle scene, unknown source culture, and instructions to keep the activity without cultural decoration.
prompt: Allowed ABSTAIN but did not reliably prevent generated invented cultural restrictions.
generation: Qwen invented graffiti-related cultural checks despite proposing no edit.
contract_validation: String lists were valid structurally; there was no no-edit/check consistency policy.
postprocessing: Copied the generated cultural reason and checks into ABSTAIN, adding another generic check.
fix: No-action ABSTAIN has a neutral policy reason, empty candidates and empty edit-verification requirements. The raw reason/checks remain unchanged in the audit, and normalization is coded explicitly.
